text:
Priya (PM): Quick idea 1: run a 1-week micro-pilot program for design partners. Goal: ultra-fast signal on small infra or prompt changes. 4 partners per wave, each gets a 5-7 day scoped test. Thoughts? @Ben @Carla
Ben (Eng): I like the speed. 1 week means minimal infra churn. Need a clear "safe operations" scope list (no routing changes without infra sign-off).
Carla (GTM): Good for outreach velocity. Who do we target first? existing accounts with concrete latency or cost owners?
Mateo (Design): Prefer partners who can ship small input sets and run weekly bench demos. Also want a tiny visual perf dashboard for them.
Anya (Solutions): Incentive thought: $1k credits + co-auth whitepaper plus a short playbook on rollout. Partners want repeatable rollouts.
Priya (PM): Proposed partner profile: latency-sensitive app OR high per-call cost + can run synthetic workload. Commitment: 1-week dedicated feedback + 30m demo.
Rey (SRE): We'll need canary windows and a revert button. For model/quant changes plan for immediate fallback to baseline model. Ops needs 48h notice to provision canary.
DevRelBot: Survey scaffold created: https://forms.gle/micro-pilot-feedback (results -> #dp-micro-feedback). Auto-reminder set 2 days post-demo. :robot_face:
Priya (PM): Draft intake rubric (scores):
```
- Product fit (0-4): alignment with our roadmap and measurable KPI
- Eval readiness (0-4): has someone to run prompt sets + metric capture
- Data sensitivity (0-2): PII or regulated data presence (lower is better)
- Infra impact (0-2): expected load and network risk
- Commitment (0-4): demo + survey + contact availability
```
Priya (PM): Max = 16. Threshold to run = 10+.
Ben (Eng): Add a short binary "requires infra changes" flag. If yes -> escalate and schedule 72h lead.
Mateo (Design): Can we include an "actionability" note on the intake form: will this produce a shipable change or a spec?
Priya (PM): Yes. Add field: "Expected outcome" with options: ship/iterate/stop/spec.
Carla (GTM): Recruitment funnel: 1) early adopters with PQAs (prod query analytics) flagged, 2) top AE referrals, 3) inbound signups. I'll push a short outreach template.
Anya (Solutions): I'll create an AE checklist (90s pitch + eligibility questions).
Rey (SRE): Ops checklist to run micro-pilot:
- baseline metrics captured
- canary env + credentials provisioned
- alert thresholds defined (error rate, p50/p95 latency)
- rollback plan documented
- SRE on-call aware

Ben (Eng): Engineering "safe-scope" options (pick one or two):
- Prompt variant only (low lift)
- Prompt + light config (no routing)
- Model param tweak on compatible model (requires infra sign-off)
- Custom eval harness (helpful, low risk)

Priya (PM): Proposed launch rules:
- Signed MOU + data terms if needed
- Intake score >= 10
- No PII without DPA
- Canary and rollback verified
- Partner agrees to at least one demo slot

Carla (GTM): Success criteria per pilot: at least one of the following:
- measurable improvement vs baseline (latency down >=10% OR cost-per-call down >=15%) with >=95% non-regression on errors
- or a clear roadmap decision (ship/iterate/stop) documented
- partner satisfaction >= 4/5 on post-survey

Mateo (Design): Also log "actionable artifact" (spec + sample prompts or dashboard) as part of success.
Ben (Eng): Technical safety: any regression in error-rate >5% requires immediate rollback.
Priya (PM): Timeline ask: finalize intake form, outreach template, infra checklist by Wed EOD so we can kick the first wave next Monday.
Carla (GTM): I'll draft outreach + pipeline tag today and share in #product-sales.
Jordan (Infra): I'll reserve canary slots Mon-Fri next week and share the calendar. Need the partner list by Friday.
Ben (Eng): I'll author the safe-scope list and a short runbook for minimal eng support.
Mateo (Design): I'll produce a one-page eval rubric + sample prompt pack.
Anya (Solutions): AE checklist + 90s outreach will be ready tonight.
Priya (PM): If no blockers, I'll lock criteria Thurs 9am PT and start outreach. Drop urgent blockers here. :eyes:
